com.vector.cfg.model.formula

Interface IFormulaExpressionService


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @ThreadSafe
public interface IFormulaExpressionService
    The IFormulaExpressionService is a project service which provides several methods to evaluate a MIFormulaExpression, and set its value as well.

    Get Formula Value

    The formula expressions can contain a simple numeric literal, a boolean literal, or a more advanced expression that handles references to autosar model elements, arithmetic functions, special functions, and special values. The method getValue(MIFormulaExpression) evaluates the expression and returns the evaluation result as an IFormulaResult.

    Set Formula Value

    Replacing the content of a MIFormulaExpression with a simple numeric value is possible using the following methods:
    • setValue(MIFormulaExpression, Number): Replaces the content of the provided formula expression with the provided numeric value.
    • #setValue(MIFormulaExpression, boolean): Replaces the content of the provided formula expression with the string representation of the provided Boolean value.

    Important remark: These operations must run within a unit of work. The client code is responsible for opening the transaction before calling these two methods.
